content.text: Digital creators often face challenges when trying to sell their products online without access to platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-15|stripe]] or PayPal. This is particularly true in regions where these services are restricted or unavailable. Cloudflare R2 offers a robust and cost-effective solution for storing and delivering digital products, allowing creators to maintain control while minimizing platform fees. This guide will break down how Cloudflare R2 can empower you to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital goods without the traditional payment processors, all while keeping more of your earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage solution designed to handle large amounts of data and deliver it efficiently. For digital creators, this means you can store your ebooks, courses, and templates securely without incurring the exorbitant fees typically charged by platforms like Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut from each sale. Instead, with NOW[[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-12|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-12|Tron USDT]], you only pay a nominal 0.5% fee on transactions, retaining more of your hard-earned revenue. This matters because it allows you to maximize your profits and sustain your creative endeavors without the constraints of conventional payment platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture leveraging Cloudflare R2 is built on a foundation of free and open-source tools, making it highly scalable and efficient. R2 integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers, which handle the backend logic and automate the delivery of digital products upon purchase. When a customer pays using cryptocurrencies processed through NOWPayments, the payment verification is immediate, triggering an automated webhook that delivers the purchased product instantly. This eliminates manual intervention, ensuring a smooth customer experience while allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators across regions where traditional payment methods are restricted or non-existent. Creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela can leverage this stack to bypass the hurdles imposed by payment processors. Whether you sell ebooks, software, or digital designs, this architecture provides a pathway that empowers you to take control of your commerce without the limitations of platforms like Stripe or PayPal. It’s for anyone who values sovereignty over their digital sales.
Save more money by avoiding platform fees with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this setup include Cloudflare R2 for storage, Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. When a purchase is made, the transaction is verified on-chain, and products are delivered automatically through secure links. This streamlined process not only enhances user experience but also reduces operational overhead. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all necessary blueprints and templates to implement this architecture efficiently, ensuring you have everything you need to launch your digital store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your digital store using Cloudflare R2, first, subscribe to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which provides all the necessary resources. Next, set up your Cloudflare account and create an R2 bucket for your digital products. Then, configure Cloudflare Workers to handle requests and automate product delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing. Following these steps will establish your digital storefront with minimal fees and full control over your assets.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Cloudflare R2 ensures fast and reliable delivery of your digital goods.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products without Gumroad?
You can leverage Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing payments. This setup allows you to sell directly to your customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad.
What are the costs associated with using Cloudflare R2?
Cloudflare R2 offers competitive pricing, and combined with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee per transaction, you'll save significantly compared to platforms that charge higher percentages like Gumroad.
Is it complicated to set up Cloudflare R2?

Not at all. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you’ll receive step-by-step instructions and templates to simplify the deployment process, making it accessible even for those without technical expertise.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products?
Yes, Cloudflare R2 supports various digital products including ebooks, courses, templates, and software, allowing you to diversify your offerings in one streamlined platform.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving you flexibility in payment options and catering to a global audience.
